name: Canvas Statusbar
description: Status bar UI component rendered in the #statusbar element. Displays zoom percentage with lock/unlock toggle icon, workspace name, and a 'view all' (fitAll) button. Shows a reset-zoom refresh icon when zoom is not 100% and not locked. Supports callbacks for lock toggle, fitAll, and resetZoom.

methods.name: update
methods.signature: (locked: boolean, scale: number, workspaceName: string, onLockToggle: (() => void) | null, fitAll: () => void, resetZoom?: (() => void) | null) => void
